copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: Claude 会用 vercel 命令行把你的网页应用部署到 Vercel(可选生产或预览环境),部署前先跑本地构建,部署后检查状态和链接能否访问,再把地址给你;也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、上线或发布网页应用,或要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量等时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude uses the vercel CLI to deploy your web app to Vercel (production or preview), running a local build first and checking deployment status and whether the live URL responds before giving you the link. It also manages Vercel projects, domains and env vars.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Builds locally, deploys, verifies the URL

say_en.text: Pull the Vercel env vars into a local .env
